Abstract. This policy defines the types of leave available at Nexora Technologies, how leave accrues, who may approve it,
and how unused leave is carried forward or encashed. It applies to all employees in grades G1 to G6 across the Lahore,
Karachi and Islamabad offices. Leave is planned on a calendar-year basis (1 January to 31 December). Tables and figures
in this document summarise the numeric limits; in case of conflict the tables prevail.
Keywords: leave policy, annual leave, sick leave, maternity leave, carry forward, encashment, approval workflow
1. Purpose and Scope
Nexora believes that rest and personal time improve the quality of engineering and customer work. The purpose
of this policy is to give employees clear entitlements while giving managers enough predictability to plan
delivery. The policy covers paid leave, unpaid leave, public holidays and the process for requesting and
approving absence. Contract staff and interns are governed by their contract and are entitled only to leave
stated in it.
2. Leave Entitlements
Table 1 lists every leave type. Entitlements are stated in working days (Monday to Friday) per calendar year
unless marked one-off. Employees on probation (first 3 months) accrue leave but may only use casual and sick
leave until confirmation, except with written approval from the department head.

2.1 Annual Leave Accrual
Annual leave accrues monthly at 1.67 working days, reaching 20 days by the end of December. New joiners
accrue leave from their date of joining on a pro-rata basis; joining on or before the 15th of a month counts as a
full month. Figure 2 shows the cumulative balance over a full year for an employee who takes no leave.

3. Requesting and Approving Leave
All leave is requested through the HRMS portal. Verbal approval or email alone is not sufficient for payroll
purposes. The line manager must act on a request within 2 working days; requests that receive no response
within that period are escalated automatically to the department head.
Figure 3. Leave request and approval workflow.

Important: Absence of 3 or more consecutive working days without approval or communication is treated as unauthorised
absence and may lead to action under the disciplinary process in the Employee Handbook (NX-HR-002, Section 8).
4. Carry Forward and Encashment
• A maximum of 10 days of unused annual leave carries forward to the next calendar year and must be used
by 31 March; any carried-forward balance not used by then lapses.
• Annual leave above the carry-forward cap may be encashed in January at the rate of monthly basic salary
divided by 30 per day.
• Casual and sick leave cannot be carried forward or encashed.

Employee Leave Policy > Page 4

• On resignation or termination, unused annual leave (up to 20 days) is encashed in the final settlement at the
same rate; negative leave balance is deducted from the final settlement.
• Employees are encouraged to take at least 10 consecutive days of annual leave once a year.
5. Public Holidays
Nexora observes public holidays notified by the Government of Pakistan, including 5 February (Kashmir Day),
23 March (Pakistan Day), 1 May (Labour Day), 14 August (Independence Day), Eid ul-Fitr, Eid ul-Adha, Ashura
and 25 December (Quaid-e-Azam Day). The exact calendar is published by HR each January. If an employee is
required to work on a public holiday for operational reasons (for example on-call duty defined in the Deployment
SOP, NX-ENG-002), a compensatory day off is granted within 30 days.
6. References
[1] Nexora Employee Handbook, NX-HR-002, Section 4 (Working Hours and Attendance).
[2] Nexora Benefits Guide, NX-HR-003, Section 5 (Medical Insurance and Maternity Cover).
[3] Government of Pakistan, Cabinet Division: annual notification of public holidays.
